newsitem.title: UK: EBRD sets five equity-linked peseta issues.
newsitem.headline: EBRD sets five equity-linked peseta issues.

text.p: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development has launched five equity linked peseta issues for a total of 7.5 billion pesetas, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Thursday.

All bonds mature in 2001. Tranche A has a coupon of 4.30 pct and an issue price of 102.0, tranche B has a coupon of 4.35 pct and an issue price of 101.0, tranche C has a coupon of 4.40 pct, issue price par, tranche D has a coupon of 4.45 pct and an issue price of 99.0 and tranche E has a coupon of 4.50 pct and an issue price of 98.0
The pay date is April 25. Denominations are 500,000 pesetas. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7658
